text.description_html:
Deltana DSH4R5TT 4" x 4" x 5/8" Radius Leaf x Square Corner Leaf THERMA-TRU Spring Hinge

These 4" spring door hinges are made out of steel. They have a 5/8" radius on one leaf and a square corner on the other.

Direct fit replacement for THERMA-TRU door spring hinges (4 Inch Square & Rounded Corner).

Packaged complete with One Single Action Spring Door Hinge, Allen Wrench, Adjusting Pin, Locking Pin plus #10 x 1" Wood Screws and #10-24 x 1/2" machine screws. Utilizes Zigzag Hole pattern for THERMA-TRU doors.

Specifications:

  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: 5/8" Radius Leaf
  • Corners: Square Leaf
  • Thickness: 0.097" (Residential)
  • THERMA-TRU Door Hole Pattern
  • Hinge Pin: Steel
  • Wood Screws: #10 x 1"
  • Machine Screws: #10 x 1/2"
  • Hinge Material: Solid Steel
  • Available Finish: 3 Finishes
  • Deltana DSH4R5TT Hinge Specifications (PDF)

*Sold Individually.
